title: protobuf: hide toplevel fields
description:
While working on wireshark/wireshark!23289 I noticed that there was a lot of info in the "Info" column. This is because there are many toplevel fields in the MySQL X protobuf messages.

This PR adds a setting to hide they key=value pairs in the Info column.

With this setting disabled:
![image](/uploads/127c444d9bd08a7f86e2817f116768ed/image.png){width=900 height=513}

With this setting enabled:
![image](/uploads/516b75c9d6f8145f6b966d21d35ad1fe/image.png){width=900 height=513}

With this setting disabled:
```
(PROTOBUF) Mysqlx.Resultset.ColumnMetaData type=BYTES collation=255 length=15 flags=16 name original_name table original_table schema catalog (PROTOBUF) Mysqlx.Resultset.Row field (PROTOBUF) Mysqlx.Resultset.FetchDone (PROTOBUF) Mysqlx.Notice.Frame type=3 scope=LOCAL payload (PROTOBUF) Mysqlx.Sql.StmtExecuteOk
```

With this setting enabled:
```
(PROTOBUF) Mysqlx.Resultset.ColumnMetaData (PROTOBUF) Mysqlx.Resultset.Row (PROTOBUF) Mysqlx.Resultset.FetchDone (PROTOBUF) Mysqlx.Notice.Frame (PROTOBUF) Mysqlx.Sql.StmtExecuteOk
```

Again the same, but with newlines added before every `(PROTOBUF)`:

With this setting disabled:
```
(PROTOBUF) Mysqlx.Resultset.ColumnMetaData type=BYTES collation=255 length=15 flags=16 name original_name table original_table schema catalog 
(PROTOBUF) Mysqlx.Resultset.Row field 
(PROTOBUF) Mysqlx.Resultset.FetchDone 
(PROTOBUF) Mysqlx.Notice.Frame type=3 scope=LOCAL payload 
(PROTOBUF) Mysqlx.Sql.StmtExecuteOk
```

With this setting enabled:
```
(PROTOBUF) Mysqlx.Resultset.ColumnMetaData 
(PROTOBUF) Mysqlx.Resultset.Row 
(PROTOBUF) Mysqlx.Resultset.FetchDone 
(PROTOBUF) Mysqlx.Notice.Frame 
(PROTOBUF) Mysqlx.Sql.StmtExecuteOk
```

Not sure about the `(PROTOBUF)` string which repeats and also eats up some space.
